items.applies_to: as-cast as well as the annealed samples
items.quote: The XRD analyses (a DRON-3M diffractometer used Cu K␣ filtered radiation) of the as-cast as well as the annealed samples show that they contained all the three borides (TiB, Ti3 B4 and TiB2 ) and that the performed annealing increased the Ti3 B4 content.

items.label: binary Ti-55 at.% B and Ti-61 at.% alloys B
items.quote: To verify temperatures of these reactions few key experiments with binary Ti-55 at.% B and Ti-61 at.% alloys B were performed by XRD and thermal analysis in the frame of this work. The samples were prepared by arc melting using the same materials and procedures as described above.
One piece of each alloy was annealed for 1 h in argon gettered by Ta at 2373 K.
